title: Leaving the Military, Without the Myths
gist: Sailor Pulse podcast episode notes: Sitreps founders discuss myths, bad advice and scams around leaving the military and how veterans are placed into defense tech and private equity roles. Thin show-notes text only.

themes.theme: Veteran transition into defense tech and private equity

insights.claim: Sitreps, a recruiting firm and online community co-founded by West Point graduate and Wharton MBA Wyatt Frasier, places veterans transitioning out of the military into defense tech and private equity roles.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Defense tech and PE are actively absorbing veteran talent, a sign of sector hiring demand.

insights.claim: Service members' decisions to leave the military are clouded by fears, bad advice and outright scams, per the Sitreps founders.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Veteran-transition services market is noisy; credible intermediaries have an edge.
insights.quote: they take apart the fears, bad advice, and outright scams that cloud the decision to leave

insights.claim: The episode frames veteran transition outcomes as bimodal, aiming to identify what separates veterans who thrive after service from those who flounder.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Talent pipeline quality for defense-tech firms depends on transition support.
